hooks.command: echo 'fandhe-frontend: 日本語でやりとり / 作業は subagent へ委譲し main 消費を抑える (delegation.md, delegation-impl.md) / Conventional Commits 厳守 (--no-verify 禁止) / implement-issue は計画承認後に実装 / core は既定エスケープ・forbid(unsafe_code)・外部依存ゼロを厳守'

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rs) command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if ! out=$(rustfmt --edition 2021 -- "$f" 2>&1); then printf 'warning: rustfmt --edition 2021 failed, %s was left unformatted (edit kept)\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 1; fi;; esac
